products.name: Rejuvenating Serum
products.short_description: Experience the ultimate Vitamin C complex Serum with Vitamin E that drenched skin in a cocktail of dynamic multi source antioxidants which help Moisturize the skin.
products.description:
Experience the ultimate Vitamin C complex Serum with Vitamin E that drenched skin in a cocktail of dynamic multi source antioxidants which help Moisturize the skin.

Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate, Kakadu Plum, Phloretin, Astaxanthin, Ferulic Acid and Vitamin E offer restorative nourishment to skin which has become compromised over time.

Direction:

AM and PM apply 2 to 3 drops of serum to the face and decollete following thorough cleansing of the skin. Allow to absorb.

Skin Type:

MATURE, HYPERPIGMENTED, ALL SKIN TYPES
products.benefits:
Benefits:

• Phloretin – A powerful anti-oxidant.

• Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate – Highly effective water-soluble anti-oxidant. Acts as a collagen biosynthesis regulator, helping to trigger collagen production. Also helps to prevent the breakdown of cells due to environmental exposure. Anti-inflammatory properties soothe damaged skin.

• Astaxanthin – Strong anti-oxidant vitamin, 550 times more powerful than vitamin E.

• Ferulic Acid – Is an anti-oxidant that neutralizes free radicals and helps to prevent damage to cells caused by ultraviolet light. Exposure to ultraviolet light increases the anti-oxidant potency of ferulic acid.

• Emblica® – Derived from Phyllanthus Emblica fruit. It is a free cascading anti-oxidant that promotes skin lightening reducing hyperpigmentation. Emblica® is completely free of pro-oxidation activity utilizing a multilevel cascade of anti-oxidant resulting in a prolongation of its anti-oxidant capabilities including the protection against photo-damage.

• Kakadu Plum – Has the highest naturally occurring vitamin C content of any fruit. It contains 3000mg of vitamin C per 100g of fruit – over 50 times the concentration found in oranges.

Aqua (Purified Water), Alcohol Denat, Propanediol, Glycerin, Aqua (and) Butylene Glycol (and) Ethoxydiglycol (and) Ferula Assa-Foetida Extract, Aqua (and) Sodium Hyaluronate (and) Gluconolactone (and) Sodium Benzoate, Terminalia Ferdinandiana Fruit Extract, Emblica Officinalis Fruit Extract, Panthenol, Polysorbate-20, 1,2-Hexanediol (and) Caprylyl Glycol (and) Tropolone, Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Tocopherol, Polyglyceryl-6 Caprylate (and) Polyglyceryl-3 Cocoate (and) Polyglyceryl-4 Caprate (and) Polyglyceryl-6 Ricinoleate, Ferulic Acid, Tocopheryl Acetate, Sodium Hydroxide, Pentaerythrityl Tetraisostearate (and) Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride (and) Stearalkonium Hectorite (and) Propylene Carbonate (and) Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Astaxanthin, Phloretin.

products.name: Multi Vitamin Serum
products.short_description: Refresh and awaken a radiant glow with this Vitamin-rich intensive facial oil. An intoxicating blend of exotic essential oils, nurturing plant oils, luminosity defining actives and a multi-vitamin complex elevates and promotes a radiant , supple complexion.
products.description:
Refresh and awaken a radiant glow with this Vitamin-rich intensive facial oil. An intoxicating blend of exotic essential oils, nurturing plant oils, luminosity defining actives and a multi-vitamin complex elevates and promotes a radiant , supple complexion.

Restore Dehydrated Skin, Promotes Radiant Glow with Kukui & Watermelon Oil

Directions:

Following cleansing, dispense 1-2 drops of Facial Oil onto clean fingertips and lightly sweep over face, neck and decolletage with upward and outward movement. Allow to absorb.

Skin Type:

MATURE, DEHYDRATED, ALL SKIN TYPES
products.benefits:
Benefits:

• Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate – Is a newly developed esterified derivative from Vitamin C with highest stability among all Vitamin C derivatives. It can be absorbed and transferred into Vitamin C effectively. It is a useful anti-oxidant.

• Lumiskin™ – Is a solution of diacetyl-boldine and caprylic/capric triglycerides that inhibit the activity of tyrosinase. It is used for its skin lightening properties.

• Aleurites Moluccana (Kukui) Seed Oil – Kukui Nut Oil is rich in fatty acids such as linoleic acid and oleic acid which can help hydrate, calm skin, and reduce inflammation. It’s a great ingredient for dry, mature skin.

• Citrullus Lanatus (Watermelon) Seed Oil – Kalahari Melon Oil, also referred to as wild watermelon seed oil, is cold-pressed extracted from the African Citrullus lanatus species. The Kalahari melon is an ancestor of the watermelon that is commercially distributed. This virgin oil has a golden yellow appearance with a mild aroma, and an omega-6 fatty acid content comparable to that of evening primrose oil, making it an ideal ingredient in skincare formulations. It has natural moisturizing and emollient properties. The oil that is extracted from the seeds of the Kalahari melon yields an oil naturally high in linoleic acid, the fatty acid known for its skincare benefits.
